title: Update Easy2Contact logo

requirements.text: Replace the existing Easy2Contact logo with a new design that maintains brand consistency while providing a fresh, professional appearance suitable for a B2B lead generation platform
acceptanceCriteria: New logo is visible in the Navigation component header
Logo maintains appropriate sizing and spacing in both desktop and mobile views
Logo design is professional and aligns with the B2B lead generation industry
Logo file is optimized for web performance

constraints: Preserve existing Navigation component structure and routing functionality
Maintain responsive design across all viewport sizes
nonGoals: Changing the company name or brand identity beyond the logo
Modifying other branding elements like color scheme or typography
Updating logos or branding in locations other than the main navigation header

required: Modern, professional B2B company logo for Easy2Contact with clean typography and geometric elements, suitable for a lead generation platform (easy2contact-logo.dim_240x80.png)
